units.rationale: Journey declares ordering [] and sharedState issue-fixtures-ready/fixture-set.issue-surfaces@2 which is produced by preparation:issue-fixtures at call:preparation:issue-fixtures:16 with dependsOnTags app.session, certificate.trust, fixture.corpus, issue.surface, lane.instance, source.connection, source.session, source.webdav as stored in Regression/preparations/issue-fixtures.md:176-185. Empty ordering is correct because neither Scenario produces state the other consumes; coupling via host WebDAV is serialised by lane device single runner and staleness is handled by tag invalidation via StateHandle.is_valid, not an edge. No member carries mainGateFor and both list the same prerequisite, so no MainGate is promoted to a Journey join.

Four cases each bind own host.preflight webdav-regression call (01/11/21/31) whose handler at regression_operation_adapter.py:5181-5185 returns runtimePath, missingPathAddress, httpAddress and unreachableAddress on same payload, so boundary inputs are real preflight outputs; _accessibility_type at 756 restricts textFile result references to /runtimePath and secret true demands file pair, which calls 08/18/28/38 obey with textJSONKey user/password. The distinct failures map to real product categories: 401/403→credentialsRejected and 404/410→invalidAddress at WebDAVDataSourceAdapter.swift:89-92, http→requiresHTTPS via RemoteConnectionFailureDiagnoser, and unreachable https:1→serverUnreachable. App relaunch at calls 02/12/22/32 preserves certificate.trust (invalidatesTags at host.preflight 2824 include certificate.trust but scenario uses relaunch not resetState, and TestCommandChannel.swift:1168 deletes server-certificate-fingerprint only on resetState), so trust from preparation call 13 FileBrowsing-CertificateTrust-trust survives. Rubric criteria 1-3 are decidable from one accessibility.inspect@2 artifact (4344 returns matchedElement plus response with full hierarchy) where statusLine at ConnectionFormPanel.swift:288-302 hides icon and combines children so label is whole message from 366-377 distinct per case, and form survival without sidebar row plus dismissed modal path at FilesScreen.swift:208/484 proves no trust handoff.

Replacement is driven not injected: issue.present@1 at 6509 maps source-file-missing→missing-object and server-certificate-changed→certificate-rotation and its second call taps public PlayerUI-loadFailure-primary when current != none (regression_operation_adapter.py:6554-6559) before activating next recipe, matching MainView.swift:1272 where Retry nils userVisibleIssue only when activePlaybackFailure is nil, so slot is replaced not dismissed and finally block restores by receiptID. Both obligations bind own inspect artifact (calls 03 and 06) where response.hierarchy is whole app.debugDescription and matchedElement plus observations are inlined; ISSUE_SLOT_POLICY at 871 and PlaybackUserVisibleIssue.swift:293-315 give Playback Error with primary Retry+secondary Close vs Server Certificate Changed with only Close, so titles and actions are decidable. Call 05 with no requireMatchedElement records one unmatched observation for PlayerUI-playbackIssue-confirm (4344 returns succeeded true with matched false) and call 06 inlines 03/response, 03/matchedElement and 05/observations lease-locally via relatedResults, so criterion 1 is checked against predecessor without relaunch and without dismissing the first alert; single lane device and single attempt satisfy oracle-protocol case-conjunction.
